name: $AVGO Observer

tweets.text: Tomahawk 6 这条线确实值得盯，Celestica 把它做成可部署的 DS6005，说明 CPO 不再只是概念。不过量产节奏和客户导入才是关键，102.4Tbps 的纸面容量落到实际部署还要看功耗和良率能不能跟上。
光互连的需求故事不缺，缺的是合格产能。博通第三代 CPO 平台和扩产计划都指向这一点：良率上不去，新增产线也只是先花钱。罗博特科那边的设备订单和 CPO 晶圆测试合作，倒是可以当个观察点，看这条链能不能真的跑起来。
PEG of 0.34 puts AVGO in the same bucket as NVDA on this list, cheap for the growth if the growth shows up. After Friday's 5.5% drop to $326.08, that's the part I'd want to see proven, not assumed.
10月这轮轮动确实不只是AVGO一家的问题，AI四家合计少了1.72万亿，钱是先去了防守方向。AVGO单月少1130亿、收在1.47万亿这个量级，跌幅放在整张榜里看就不算最极端的那档。接下来先看11月3日AMD财报给需求定个调，再看11月中下旬NVDA那份。
周五跌 5.5% 到 326.08 美元那天，DA Davidson 反而把 $AVGO 从 Neutral 上调到 Buy，目标价 350 提到 400 美元。它的算法是：按 2027 年预期市盈率 16 倍算，现价基本没给 Anthropic 和 OpenAI 那两笔资本运作留任何兑现空间。市场那天按信用定价，研报按兑现概率算账，分歧就在这儿。

That framing is the interesting part. $AVGO at $326.08 is now below all three moving averages, while the street still sits at Moderate Buy with a $530.52 average target. Cheap only matters if the AI book keeps delivering, and that is the part to watch into the Dec 9 print.

Fair question. Intel's PC slump and Broadcom's custom AI book are different stories, and the $16.7B, +221% quarter is what has to carry the multiple. Friday didn't make that distinction: $326.08, below all three moving averages. The AI book has to prove it from here. $AVGO

19x forward earnings makes the pullback easier to read, but I would still separate the multiple from the earnings case. The 10/30 close was $326.08, down 5.5%, and consensus is Moderate Buy with a $530.52 average target. That gap alone does not settle the growth question.
周五这根阴线，讲的不是需求变了，是钱变贵了。$AVGO 跌 5.5% 到 326.08 美元，纳指跌 2.86%，费半约 7.2%，AMD 跌 10.9%。同一天黑石改口说 Anthropic 上市后可能只拿 BB 档垃圾级，博通 CDS 被传走阔到 175.4 个基点、创纪录。评级机构还没正式裁定，别把预期当定论。
网络这块确实容易被算力叙事盖住。博通的打法跟 Arista 不一样，一个卖芯片、一个卖整机加软件，云厂商自研交换系统那条线会一直压着议价，单看端口速度不够，还得看 AI 网络收入到底占多少。
交换这层确实容易被低估，博通卖芯片不卖整机，云厂商自己组系统这点很关键。昨收 $345.00，刚好在 20 日均线 $347.15 下面，网络收入能不能兑现还得看后续。

Broadcom at +306% expected profit growth over four years puts it near the top of this list, behind only a few names. That is the expectation, not a result. At $345, below all three moving averages, the market is still asking whether execution keeps up. $AVGO

Trainium going outside AWS in late 2027 says custom-silicon demand is bigger than one cloud. AWS grew 39% to $46B, backlog $578B, and 2027 capex goes higher still. Demand is real. So is the cash-flow pressure, and $AVGO sits right in that tension.

The 29% figure stands out. Server demand looks broad, but Broadcom's XPU share slipping while other customers have yet to ramp is a timing risk. At $345.00, still below the 20-, 50- and 200-day averages, so caution into the Dec 9 earnings makes sense.
Alphabet 电话会把 TPU 从故事讲成了订单。云收入 307 亿美元，同比翻倍；云积压订单 5610 亿美元，TPU 客户近 100 家，2027 年资本开支还要显著增加。Anthropic 经博通采购 TPU 也被点名了。$AVGO 收 345 美元，跌 1.9%。
